name: Proofwp – Visual Product Reviews for WooCommerce
author: Debuggers Studio

sections.description:
ProofWP is an all-in-one WooCommerce product review plugin that helps online stores collect, manage, and display customer reviews, photo reviews, video reviews, star ratings, testimonials, trust badges, and user-generated content (UGC). Increase customer trust, strengthen social proof, and boost conversions with authentic product reviews and customer feedback.

Automatically send post-purchase review request emails, collect photo and video reviews from verified customers, and showcase beautiful review widgets, testimonial sliders, rating badges, and social proof notifications anywhere on your WooCommerce store.

Live Demo Store | Documentation | Upgrade to Pro

Why ProofWP?

Research shows 93% of buyers read reviews before purchasing. Most WooCommerce stores display plain text reviews that nobody notices. ProofWP changes that with visual, media-rich review displays that actually convert.

ProofWP is designed for WooCommerce stores looking to increase customer trust, improve conversion rates, showcase user-generated content, and build a stronger online reputation through authentic customer reviews.

When shoppers see real photos, videos, and star ratings from other customers, they buy faster and with more confidence. That is social proof, and ProofWP makes it easy to collect, moderate, and display it across your entire WooCommerce store.

Key Features

Review Display & Widgets

  • Multiple Review Layouts – Display customer reviews using Grid, Slider, Stack Slider (Pro), Accordion Slider (Pro), Marquee (Pro), and Masonry Feed (Pro) layouts.
  • Modern Review Feed & Collection Forms – Transform default WooCommerce reviews into a modern, responsive review feed with review summaries, filtering, and advanced display options. Display review feeds, collection forms, or both directly inside the native WooCommerce Reviews tab to create a seamless customer feedback experience.
  • Product Tags in Reviews – Display the reviewed product within review widgets, helping shoppers easily identify which product each review refers to..
  • Floating Review Widgets (Pro) – Keep customer reviews visible as shoppers browse your store with customizable floating widgets.
  • Display Conditions (Pro) – Control exactly where review widgets appear across products, pages, categories, cart, and checkout screens.
  • WooCommerce & Theme Integration – Embed customer reviews, testimonials, ratings, and social proof sections anywhere on your site using flexible widgets and shortcodes, with full compatibility across WooCommerce, Elementor, Gutenberg, block themes, and classic WordPress themes.

Review Collection & Automation

  • Automated Review Collectionncrease review submissions with on-site review forms, post-purchase review request emails, and order delivery-based review requests.
  • Photo & Video Reviews – Allow customers to upload multiple photos or videos with each review to create authentic user-generated content (UGC) and visual social proof.
  • Guest & Anonymous Reviews – Accept reviews from guest customers without requiring account registration and optionally keep reviewer names hidden from the public.
  • Follow-Up Review Reminder Emails (Pro) – Automatically send reminder emails to customers who have not submitted a review.
  • Review Compliance & Security – Protect review forms with Google reCAPTCHA and optional customer consent agreements.

Trust & Social Proof

  • Star Ratings & Review Summaries – Display product ratings, review counts, and review summaries throughout your WooCommerce store.
  • Verified Customer Reviews – Highlight reviews from verified purchasers to increase credibility and customer trust.
  • Trust Badges – Display trust badges on product pages, cart pages, and checkout pages to improve purchase confidence.
  • Social Proof Notifications – Show real-time purchase and review activity notifications to create urgency and encourage conversions.
  • Review Schema Markup – Add structured review data to help star ratings appear in Google search results.
  • Review Summary Positioning & Alignment Controls (Pro) – Customize the placement and alignment of review summaries within feeds and widgets.

Review Management

  • Review Moderation & Management – Approve, edit, organize, and manage customer reviews from a centralized dashboard before publishing them.
  • Centralized Management Dashboard – Manage reviews, widgets, email requests, and plugin settings from a single location.
  • Built-In Performance Optimization – Improve review widget performance and reduce page load times with built-in caching.
  • Demo Review Generator – Quickly populate review widgets with sample reviews to help design and test your store’s review experience.

Migration & Import

  • Review Migration Tools – Easily switch from ReviewX, Customer Reviews for WooCommerce, Judge.me, and other review plugins by importing your existing customer reviews, ratings, and social proof without losing valuable review data.

SEO & Search Visibility

  • Review Schema Generator (Pro) – Automatically generate structured review schema markup to improve search visibility and help product ratings appear in search results.

What’s Next?

If you like ProofWP, then check out our other WordPress plugins designed to help you increase engagement, conversions, and sales.

ReelsWP – Easily add fast, mobile-friendly vertical video grids and reels carousels to your landing pages, blog posts, news articles, or product pages. Tag products inside videos and create shoppable video experiences.

Marquee Addons – Makes it easy to add smooth marquee effects for text, buttons, images, testimonials, videos, and cards to Elementor websites with continuous scrolling loops for your content.
sections.faq:
Why should I use photo and video reviews in WooCommerce?

Photo and video reviews create stronger social proof than text-only reviews. They help customers trust products faster and can improve conversion rates significantly.

Does ProofWP work with all WooCommerce themes and page builders?

Yes. ProofWP is compatible with most modern WooCommerce themes, WordPress websites, and popular page builders.

Can I customize the review display layout?

Yes. You can showcase reviews in multiple layouts designed to improve engagement and match your store branding.

Does ProofWP support verified customer reviews?

Yes. ProofWP supports verified WooCommerce customer reviews to help increase trust and authenticity.

Does ProofWP support review moderation?

Yes. Store owners can approve, reject, or manage customer reviews before publishing them on the website.

Are reviews stored on my own website?

Yes. All reviews are stored directly in your own WordPress database, giving you full ownership and control over your customer data.

Can I import reviews from other platforms?

Yes. You can import reviews from other popular platforms and start displaying them immediately.

Does ProofWP work with existing WooCommerce stores and reviews?

Yes. ProofWP works seamlessly with existing WooCommerce stores and can showcase your current product reviews in modern, conversion-focused layouts without losing previous customer feedback.

Can I filter or highlight the best reviews?

Yes. ProofWP allows you to showcase top customer reviews, photo reviews, and video testimonials to increase product credibility.

Does ProofWP slow down my WooCommerce store?

ProofWP is optimized for performance and designed to work efficiently with WooCommerce stores while maintaining fast loading speeds.

Does ProofWP support SEO and Google rich snippets?

Yes. ProofWP supports review schema and user-generated content that can help improve product page SEO, search visibility, and click-through rates.
